proposed_from.topic: Signal-aware oracle-adaptation modulus for dependent causal-panel completion on Ferrers masks. Observe one Gaussian rank-r panel Y=M+sigma L_N Z L_T' on a deterministic Ferrers mask with nonvanishing complete slabs, fixed-rank incoherent M, bounded slab Gram geometry, and unknown separable covariance whose inverse-Cholesky factors have bounded spectra and matched row-and-column polynomial tails. For a diffuse missing-cell causal target psi_W(M), define the truth-specific covariance-minimum tangent-balancing score and the minimax L2 distance from all feasible observed-data statistics to its oracle linearization. Derive a primitive target-sensitive necessary-and-sufficient adaptation condition retaining the unavoidable mean-tangent learning cost; construct an observable same-panel residual and tangent-balanced score, feasible variance calibration, and uniform Wald coverage on the adaptation region; and prove matching legal Gaussian lower experiments plus the non-oracle risk frontier outside it. Consumers are Ben-Michael and Feller's right-to-carry reanalysis and Choi-Yuan's SEC Tick Size Pilot analysis. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: An exact rank-one loading-class minimax theorem was derived: for post-period weights h, oracle-reproduction risk is comparable to sigma sqrt((||h||^2+1/m)/m) min(1,sigma/(a sqrt(n))); an observable unknown-signal tangent-balanced statistic attains it with feasible variance calibration. Exact known-separable-covariance profiling gives temporal information J=S_x P_T+S_b P_C and agrees with direct GLS checks below 1.2e-15. Matched-tail and paired-loading counterexamples were checked, while no published collision was verified. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove a primitive uniform target-sensitive L2 bound for the joint adaptive-score and rank-curvature remainder when both factor spaces and both nonparametric innovation factors are estimated from the same Ferrers panel, with a matching legal posterior-risk lower experiment. EARLY KILL TEST: On the half-by-half L mask with unknown rank-one row/time directions and unknown nonstationary exact-one-banded innovations, derive the same-panel residual-score remainder and matching posterior lower experiment for both one-period and full-rectangle averages; pivot if this requires supplied factor directions, an independent panel, or stronger covariance regularity. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest procedures are Choi and Yuan's subgroup-debiased causal-panel estimator and Choi, Kwon, and Liao's no-split correction. The common-subclass theorem compares both on exactly the balanced iid observable law: all three intervals share the centered strong-signal Gaussian limit, while the new result adds a necessary-and-sufficient normalized distance to the truth-specific efficient oracle and an exact weak- and intermediate-signal risk. The target sequence \(W_n\) is fixed externally rather than treated as identifiable from the law, and every risk is posed over \(P\in\mathcal P_n(W_n)\) on the common sample space \(\mathcal Y_n\). The target is not presumed to have an observed representer; the proposal states the exact quotient-identifiability condition. Column-major vectorization and \(S_\Omega\) type every observed covariance, while northwest closure is tied to the exact innovation order and the \(2\times2\) counterexample forbids a permutation-free reading. The adaptation object is generated by a finite-dimensional Gaussian sieve, an identifiable Fisher quotient, and covariant derivative norms invariant to admissible Grassmann, Stiefel, and covariance-gauge changes. The attaining statistic is a determinate composition of fixed folds, ridge rank pilots, guarded predecessor regressions, fitted-Gaussian conditional projections, a Lepski selector, and selected covariance and coefficient maps. The converse is an explicit finite product-prior Bayes-risk statement for the law-indexed random oracle, with legal rank and covariance perturbations, fixed \(W_n\), and posterior conditioning on \(\sigma(Y)\). The oracle-variance comparison is labelled novel and is explicitly verified for the balanced one-period and rectangle targets rather than attributed to Xia and Yuan. Fixed rank is anchored to Choi and Yuan's exact-rank model and bounded-\(r\) regime; Chernozhukov, Hansen, Liao, and Zhu are described only in their supported slowly growing spiked-rank regime. Zhang, Shen, and Kong are used only for bandable covariance factors, while the inverse-Cholesky tail conditions are not attributed to them. No cited result combines these objects, and no strict claim is made against inaccessible theorem text.

seed_details.seed: Truth-specific oracle-adaptation modulus on Ferrers panels
seed_details.anchor: XiaYuan2021LinearForms, Introduction, Theorem 1, and the perturbation proof in Section 7.2
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the independent random-sampling projection variance by the covariance-metric KKT representer on a deterministic Ferrers restriction, then differentiate that representer with respect to both singular spaces and both innovation factors.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for target-sensitive Ferrers linear forms, separable-covariance oracle adaptation, and feasible-to-oracle distance found no theorem combining these objects.
seed_details.red_team: The cynical objection is that this is immediate from Xia and Yuan because their variance already depends on singular-space alignment. The objection fails because their score uses independent entry sampling and supplied noise geometry, whereas the proposed theorem characterizes the minimum distance to an unavailable truth-specific covariance score and proves a converse with covariance and mean tangent jointly hidden.

seed_details.seed: Same-panel Gaussian-innovation inference under separable dependence
seed_details.anchor: ChoiYuan2024MNAR, Introduction, Theorems 3.1--3.2, proof of Theorem 3.1, and Conclusion
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace deletion-based independence in the auxiliary completion proof by an ordered Gaussian innovation filtration whose residual score is measurable on the same Ferrers panel.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for no-split low-rank completion with correlated matrix-normal innovations located Choi, Kwon, and Liao only for dependent observation indicators, not dependent residuals.
seed_details.red_team: The cynical objection is that Gaussian conditioning makes the extension routine. It fails because conditioning changes the low-rank mean and leaves a jointly estimated nonlinear tangent score; the proof must control the resulting score-curvature term in \(L_2\), not merely whiten a known residual vector.

seed_details.anchor: BenMichaelFeller2026Discussion, Sections 3--4 and the right-to-carry reanalysis
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Project the entire rectangle weight jointly against calendar-specific tangent directions before taking the covariance minimum; averaging calendar-time representers is generally not the solution of this joint projection.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for event-time matrix-completion variance under separable dependence and for event-time Ferrers tangent balancing found no exact comparison theorem.
seed_details.red_team: The cynical objection is that an event-time average is only another linear form. It fails because the oracle representer is nonlinear in the weight after covariance-metric tangent projection, and the exact loading reduction yields a \(\sqrt m\) separation in absolute adaptation cost between a one-period and a full-rectangle target.

seed_details.seed: Masked residual learning of two inverse-Cholesky factors
seed_details.anchor: Zhou2014Gemini, Introduction, Theorems 4.1 and 4.5, and Conclusion
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Prove concentration of modewise residual Gram matrices after an estimated low-rank tangent projection and under unequal Ferrers replication counts.
seed_details.destination_search: GEMINI, bandable Kronecker covariance estimation, TRCM, and BAMITA do not provide a frequentist rate for one incomplete matrix with an estimated low-rank mean.
seed_details.red_team: The cynical objection is that GEMINI already estimates both modes from one matrix. It fails because GEMINI starts from a centered complete matrix and its effective-replicate concentration does not absorb deterministic missingness or estimated-mean contamination.
seed_details.disposition: drop after deepening because covariance recovery alone does not deliver causal-target inference

seed_details.seed: Honest adaptation to weak singular-value tails and colored noise
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the fixed tangent projector by a data-dependent enlarged spectral space while retaining target alignment, implicit ridge bias, and covariance-score error uniformly.
seed_details.destination_search: Rank-robust low-rank inference and honest matrix-completion confidence sets do not cover deterministic Ferrers masks with unknown matrix-normal covariance.
seed_details.red_team: The cynical objection is that this merely combines rank robustness with covariance estimation. The objection is presently serious: the simultaneous testing lower bound is not yet anchored by a legal Ferrers experiment, so the seed is deferred rather than padded into the core.

seed_details.seed: Ferrers masks as the maximal class for observable two-sided innovations
seed_details.anchor: ChoiYuan2024MNAR, Section 2 and the staggered-adoption construction
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Characterize when every ordered lower-triangular two-sided transform has zero observed-to-missing leakage, then prove necessity by a one-edge covariance perturbation.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for Ferrers graph characterizations of observable Cholesky whitening found combinatorial Ferrers results but no statistical equivalence theorem for matrix-normal innovations.
seed_details.red_team: The cynical objection is that northwest closure makes the result elementary. It holds as a standalone contribution; the characterization is useful only as a lemma inside the adaptation paper and is not retained as the kernel.

seed_details.seed: Target-local minimax risk beyond the oracle-adaptation region
seed_details.anchor: ChaiFan2025DependentMatrix, Introduction, main minimax theorem, and concluding discussion
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Localize the dependent-noise packing to perturbations that change the covariance-minimum causal representer while preserving the Ferrers rank and covariance class.
seed_details.destination_search: No located dependent-matrix minimax result uses oracle-reproduction loss or a diffuse missing-cell linear functional.
seed_details.red_team: The cynical objection is that Chai and Fan's arbitrary-dependence lower bound subsumes this case. It fails because their loss is global matrix recovery; it need not move the target or conceal the random oracle linearization, so it cannot certify the proposed target-local frontier.
seed_details.disposition: merge into seed 1 as its converse

seed_details.seed: Covariance-aware conformal inversion for Ferrers counterfactual rectangles
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Construct an innovation-preserving permutation orbit after estimated two-sided whitening and quantify symmetry error from same-panel covariance learning.
seed_details.destination_search: Counterfactual conformal inference exists for synthetic controls, but exact permutation validity disappears under estimated nonstationary separable covariance.
seed_details.red_team: The cynical objection is that estimated whitening only adds a standard approximate-exchangeability error. The objection could hold without a sharp target-specific bound, and the present substrate gives stronger direct traction for the Wald-oracle frontier.
